android.desc:
Charging your electric car is made easy with the new version of Enel X Way: Enel On Your Way.
The Enel X Way mobile app, which allows you to manage all your electric car or hybrid car charging wherever you are, gets a makeover and becomes Enel On Your Way.
Charging your electric car is made easy with Enel On Your Way.
Enel On Your Way mobile app allows you to manage all your electric or plug-in hybrid car charging needs wherever you are.
With access to over 70.000 charging points, you can find, or filter nearby charging stations based on availability, max charging power or plug type with the built-in interactive live map.
Charge your EV with Enel On Your Way! 
Access public charging networks or manage your Waybox home charger. 
Download the app for free and register in just a few clicks. 
With intuitive navigation and features, Enel ON Your Way is an app that makes charging your EV easier. 
Enel On Your Way mobile app works on all smartphone devices and in all countries allowing you to find the closest charging station when you travel.
Enel On Your Way is convenient 
With a few clicks Enel On Your Way allows you to find where you can charge your EV, choose the rate plans that best suit your needs and customize your charging experience by entering your car make model.
Enel On Your Way is multifunctional
Pick the charging station that works for your electric or hybrid car, find charging cost or availability hours and even reserve the charging station in advance. 
Check your charging history, energy consumption, past invoices and more. 
With Enel On Your Way you can manage your home charging. 
Configure and manage a Waybox home charger for a complete charging experience.
Enel On Your Way allows you to: 
Configure one or more Waybox chargers directly from the mobile app 
Start or stop charging sessions or monitor charging progress.
Use smart charging features, postpone or delay charging start time and set its duration 
Share your Waybox with other users 
Download the app and start your journey into the world of electric mobility!
Follow us on Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/enelxglobal
